title.tr: Taş zeminde üç basamaklı ahşap merdiven
title.en: Three-step timber stairs on stone paving

alt.tr: Taş döşeme üzerinde üç basamaklı ahşap merdiven; arkada çaprazlı korkuluk ve ahşap kapaklı dolap
alt.en: Three-step timber stairs on stone paving, with a cross-braced railing and a timber-doored cabinet behind

caption.tr: Üç geniş basamak taş zeminden yükseltiye çıkıyor. Arkada ahşap kapaklı bir dolap var.
caption.en: Three wide steps rise from the stone paving to the raised level. A timber-doored cabinet stands behind.
